text:
1970 FIFA Wiadi Kɔp a wɔbɔɔ no fi 31 May kɔsi 21 June no, ɛyɛ nea wɔdi kan wɔ Mexico na ɛyɛ nea wɔdi kan a wɔyɛe wɔ Europe anaa South America akyi. Akuw 16 na ɛkoo mu, wɔkyekyee wɔn mu yɛɛ akuw anan a ɛwɔ akuw anan mu, wɔbɔɔ round-robin, na akuw a ɛdi kan mmienu wɔ akuw biara mu na wɔkɔɔ knockout stage a ɛwɔ quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off ne final mu. Ɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛyɛ adanse kɛse ma wiase a ɛrehwɛ: ɛka Wiadi Kɔp a wɔde colour bɔɔ gua no mu biako, na ɛyɛ nea wɔde satellite kɔɔ wiase nyinaa, na nnipa 1,603,975 na wɔbaa tumi no nyinaa, ɛyɛ dodoɔ a ɛfata bɛyɛ 50,124 wɔ match biara mu. Ɛyɛ Wiadi Kɔp a edi kan a wɔde yellow ne red cards yɛɛ adwuma.

Brazil, a ɛde 1958 ne 1962 nkonimdeɛ no bae, dii nkonim wɔ akansie no nyinaa mu, wɔdii match 6 nyinaa mu wɔ wɔn kwan a ɛkɔ trophy no so. Wɔfrɛɛ Pelé sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a ɛyɛ nea ɛda adi kɛse wɔ akansie no mu, na group stage no maa football ho mfonini a ɛda so daa, ɛberɛ a England goalkeeper Gordon Banks gyeɛ Pelé header no, na wɔkae sɛ ɛyɛ nsesaeɛ a ɛyɛ nea ɛsen biara wɔ game no mu. Knockout rounds no de classic foforɔ bae: Italy dii West Germany 4-3 wɔ extra time akyi wɔ semi-final mu, akansie a wɔfrɛ no 'Game of the Century' daa.

Final no, wɔ Estadio Azteca wɔ Mexico City, na nnipa 107,412 na wɔbaa hɔ, na ɛne Brazil ne Italy na ɛkoo. Pelé de Brazil dii kan wɔ 18th minute mu, na Roberto Boninsegna san de Italy dii nka wɔ 37th mu. Brazil san kɔɔ anim wɔ second half mu wɔ Gérson (66') ne Jairzinho (71') so, na Carlos Alberto siee 4-1 nkonim wɔ 86th minute mu wɔ goal a ɛde team move a ɛyɛ nea ɛda so kɛse wɔ Wiadi Kɔp mu no hyɛɛ. Brazil dii nkonim mprenu mprenu, wɔde Italy a ɛdi akyi ne West Germany a ɛwɔ mprenu so, na wɔn Gerd Müller dii nkonim sɛ top scorer wɔ goals 10. Nkonimdeɛ a ɛto mprenu mprenu no maa Brazil tumi kura Jules Rimet Trophy no daa, ɛyɛ ɔman a edi kan yɛɛ saa.
